browse_dataset_with_config: run the dataset browsing tool with a config file to visualize segmentation dataset samples
browse_dataset_save_output: browse a dataset and save visualization outputs to a specified directory instead of displaying
browse_dataset_no_show: browse a dataset without showing visualizations by passing the --not-show flag
browse_dataset_custom_interval: browse a dataset with a custom show interval in seconds between each sample
browse_dataset_cfg_options: browse a dataset with overridden config options using key=value pairs via --cfg-options
